notes:
New / edit entity (CHR-1146; shape `{id, name, type?, description?, avatar?, traits?, object?}`), saved via `set_use_cases` (`entities`). Dialog shell `uc-dialog`, 580px, drawn over `usecases-world` (`data-backdrop`).

Fields: emoji avatar (`uc-avatar entity`, click to pick; no colour — entities are squares, personas circles), Name (autofocus), Type (free text with a datalist of types in use), ID (mono, from the name; hint "shared with personas: one id names one participant; “system” is reserved" — an id a persona already has gives `ambiguous_id`, shown under the field in amber, never blocking), Description, Traits (one native select per dimension, default Any), Data object (native select, "None" until a data model exists; then the objects of `data-objects.json`). Usage line: "A member of N constellations · a state subject in N use cases".

**Error (blocks Save, decision chr1103):** ID `system` → `chrome-field mono-error`, `aria-invalid`, "system is reserved for Artisign itself. Pick another id."; footer names it, Save disabled. Pattern as `usecases-edit-dialog-branch-invalid`.

Footer: Delete (danger text, edit mode only; asks first and lists where the entity is used), Cancel, primary **Save entity** (create mode: **Create entity**). Flows → `usecases-world`.
